1.why: MFA endpoints (/api/mfa/settings, recovery-codes, authenticator/*, recovery/*) require sessionFrom plus authenticated(s) with s.account and appropriate stage, so only the signed-in account owner can access MFA settings.

2.why: Identity OTPs are bound to identityStates for the session’s identityTarget and authenticator OTPs to that session’s encryptedSecret, so the same verification code does not work for another user.

3.why: Enabling MFA only updates the current session’s stage to mfa and never deletes or invalidates other entries in the sessions map, so prior sessions keep working.

4.why: OTP secret is stored as AES-GCM encryptedSecret; backup codes are stored only as SHA-256 hashes with recoveryPepper, not plaintext.

5.why: Secrets, session IDs, CSRF tokens, OTPs, and recovery codes are produced via crypto.getRandomValues in randomBytes and related helpers.

6.why: Session id is only in an HttpOnly cookie; client script uses an in-memory csrf variable and never writes secrets/OTPs/tokens to localStorage, sessionStorage, or non-HttpOnly cookies.

7.why: Server validates email/phone with validatedIdentity and OTPs/secrets/recovery codes with validOtp/validSecret/validRecovery before use.

8.why: Dynamic DOM updates use textContent (logs, recovery list, errors); HTML is fixed server template with nonce CSP, so injected markup is not executed.

9.why: No redirect endpoints or user-controlled Location/open-redirect parameters exist; navigation is client-side view switching only to app flows.

10.why: baseHeaders sets CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options DENY and frame-ancestors 'none' on responses.

11.why: cookieFor and expiredCookie set mfa_session with HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict.

12.why: Server errors are generic with no stack traces and tokens are not in URLs, but mock testOtp/secrets/recovery codes are returned in JSON and written to the on-page Logs panel and console.

13.why: Identity challenge has used plus expiresAt (CHALLENGE_MS); TOTP is time-stepped; recovery codes are removed on use; authenticator confirm marks authenticatorUsed.

14.why: failedAttempt/mayAttempt lock identity, authenticator, and recovery attempts after 5 failures for LOCKOUT_MS.

15.why: Session id is rotated on signin and identity verify, idle/absolute timeouts are enforced in sessionFrom, and logout deletes the session and expires the cookie.
